title: Local shop
lead: Launch a visit-based loyalty program in minutes. Customers scan a QR at checkout — no crypto jargon, just PEOPLE Blockchain under the hood.
contractsOff: Loyalty contracts are not deployed on this testnet yet. Ask the operator to run the Lavka deploy workflow after merging.
pohRequired: Sign in with Google or email and link your wallet to run the shop or redeem visits.
merchantLead: Set your venue name and country, then publish a pass customers can buy or redeem.
qrRedeemHint: Customers open this link at the register to use one visit.
qrBuyHint: New customers can buy a pass here (PPL).
qrPayHint: Pay the shop directly in PPL (network fee applies).
qrEscrowHint: Prepay with escrow — funds stay locked until you confirm or the deadline passes.
termsLabel: What you are paying for (stored off-chain)
escrowLocked: Funds are locked on PEOPLE Blockchain testnet.
errorTx: Transaction failed. Check balance and try again.
errorProgramTerms: Enter 1–100 visits and a price above zero.
preliminaryBanner: Preliminary — pilot parameters may change before mainnet.
